items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: He was very nice to work with, Eddie O'Neill.

ctx.x: Yeah. This was the band leader, this boy. He was very nice to work with, Eddie O'Neill. He's so young-looking. Mimi Benzel. Mm-hmm.
Metropolitan things. Mm-hmm. No wonder I never heard of him. Fats Pichon. Mm-hmm. Let's see.
